Name: MonsterMuskInVolcano
Author: bananafruit1492
Description:
[size=5][size=3][b]MonsterMuskInVolcano[/b] is a [url=https://stardewvalley.net/]Stardew Valley[/url] mod which [b]doubles the number of monsters[/b] encountered in the [b]volcano dungeon[/b] levels when using [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Monster_Musk]Monster Musk[/url].[/size]

Install[/size]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Unzip the mod folder into Stardew Valley/Mods.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
[url=https://github.com/BananaFruit1492/MonsterMuskInVolcano]Source Code[/url]
